scenarios.name: Switch between appearance and panel visibility submenus

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the full Tools ribbon uses the Normal appearance
Team Web, Tutorials, and User Commands are enabled in Show Panels
Team Web, Tutorials, and User Commands are enabled in Show Panels
the user right-clicks the Options panel title
the user opens the Ribbon Appearance submenu
the user opens Show Panels from the same context menu
the Show Panels submenu lists Measure, Material and Appearance, Options, Clipboard, Find, Team Web, Tutorials, and User Commands with visibility checks
Team Web, Tutorials, and User Commands are checked in the captured panel state
the panel context menu remains open
the user opens Ribbon Appearance again
Normal is still marked as selected
the user clicks empty viewport space
